entries.zh: 绝人太甚，待人过分刻薄绝情（如弃人而不予一物）
entries.en: to treat people too harshly; to cast someone off without giving him anything

entries.zh: 船落水，船翻落水、覆船
entries.en: for a boat to fall into the water; to capsize, to shipwreck a boat

entries.zh: 抛柁（下锚），把船锚抛入水中
entries.en: to cast the ship's anchor into the water; to drop anchor

entries.zh: 抛落水，抛锚落水
entries.en: to throw the anchor into the water; to drop anchor

entries.zh: 完杯（原字作柸），掷杯占卜、以杯珓问吉凶
entries.en: to cast lots; to divine one's fortune by throwing divination blocks
entries.notes: 汉字栏“柸”带[疑:柸/杯]，释义据西语 echar la suerte（掷杯问卜）与汉字栏合读定夺。

entries.zh: 宿盐，往食物里加盐（放盐调味）
entries.en: to put salt in the food; to salt the food

entries.zh: 落盐，下盐、往食物里放盐
entries.en: to put salt in the food

entries.zh: 倒，躺卧、倒卧
entries.en: to lie down, to recline

entries.zh: 傍，侧身而卧、靠向一边
entries.en: to lie on one's side; to lean to one side

entries.zh: 舒倒堤，舒展身体躺卧、斜躺
entries.en: to lie down, to stretch out and recline

entries.zh: 下许育头（识字存疑），扛上肩头、搁在肩上
entries.en: to put on the shoulder; to shoulder (a load)
entries.notes: 汉字“育”带[疑:育/有]且字符串费解，释义依西语 hecharse a el hombro（上肩）定夺。

entries.zh: 倒蓿赖仜（识字存疑），翻转身来、辗转反侧（如病人卧于人家门旁）
entries.en: to turn over, to toss about (as a sick man at another's door)
entries.notes: 汉字“仜”带[疑:仜/佢]、西语例文残讹（ynose bolvir…apuerta agena），据 hecharse…volver/voltear（躺卧、翻身）推断。

entries.zh: 倒堤困，躺下睡觉、卧床而睡
entries.en: to lie down to sleep

entries.zh: 倒落水，倒入水中、跳水落水
entries.en: to throw oneself into the water; to fall into the water

entries.zh: 落水，落水、入水（跌落或跳入水中）
entries.en: to fall into the water; to plunge into the water

entries.zh: 败，败坏、变坏、毁坏
entries.en: to spoil, to go to ruin; to waste
entries.notes: 西语后半残讹且带[疑:cebado/odoy]，但 hecharse a perder（败坏）与汉字“败”互证清晰。

entries.zh: 竟，完毕、完成
entries.en: done; completed, finished

entries.zh: 做了，做好了、办完了
entries.en: done; finished, perfected

entries.zh: 权且，暂且、临时凑合着做
entries.en: done for the time being; makeshift, borrowed
entries.notes: 汉字“權”带[疑:權/榷]，取“权且”（临时）义与西语 hecho de prestado（借用、临时凑用）相合。

entries.zh: 权时，权且、暂时
entries.en: for the time being; done provisionally
entries.notes: 同条19：“權”带[疑:權/榷]，取“权时/暂时”义。
